lineage.split_name_reconciliation: screen-v2 binds the selected activity-balanced split stored as train-split-v3; train-split-v2 is the preserved rejected cut-only design and is not an estimator input

research_question: whether the frozen conditional-choice estimator is technically ready for one single protected research-confirmation execution; this round is exploratory estimator calibration only

definitions.source_degree: actor-normalized adjacency degree of the source divided by 4; zero for placement
definitions.destination_degree: actor-normalized adjacency degree of the destination divided by 4
definitions.capture_degree: adjacency degree of the captured point divided by 4; zero without capture
definitions.closes_mill: one when the settled atomic action leaves the destination in an actor mill
definitions.opponent_immediate_mill_destinations_rem: count of opponent immediate-mill destinations present before but absent after the settled action
definitions.creates_mill_fork: one when the settled action leaves at least two actor immediate-mill destinations and creates at least one of them
definitions.new_own_potential_mills: actor two-piece-one-empty mill-line count after minus before
definitions.own_mobility_delta: actor legal placement-or-move count after minus before, divided by 24
definitions.opponent_mobility_reduction: opponent legal placement-or-move count before minus after, divided by 24
definitions.captured_opponent_threat_lines: opponent lines containing the captured point with at least two opponent pieces before the action, divided by 2

specifications.primary_difference: per-player mean geometry log loss minus per-player mean full log loss

numerical_contract.objective: mean across training actor players of that player's mean exact conditional negative log likelihood, plus lambda times one half of the squared coefficient norm
numerical_contract.choice_set_normalization: one softmax denominator per complete legal atomic choice set; each actor player has equal total likelihood weight

regularization.penalized_terms: all slope coefficients including geometry controls
regularization.intercept: absent because it cancels within every choice set

standardization.statistics: unweighted float64 mean and population standard deviation over all legal-alternative rows in the training players and training games of the current fold
standardization.held_out_fold_use: transform only; held-out rows never affect means or scales

choice_construction.source: complete atomic inventory from the board-first positional oracle wrapper
choice_construction.normalization: missing from or capture becomes an empty string only for lexical ordering; original null semantics are retained for application
choice_construction.duplicates: any duplicate normalized move key fails the run; duplicates are not silently removed
choice_construction.observed_choice: must match exactly one inventory row

probability_handling.training: float64 max-shifted log-sum-exp with no probability clipping in the objective
probability_handling.reported_log_loss: negative log of the clipped chosen probability

invalid_choice_policy.single_action_choice_set: abstain from both specifications, count against evaluable coverage, and fail readiness if more than 1 percent of covered decisions
invalid_choice_policy.malom_abstention: abstain from both specifications and count against the frozen oracle coverage gate; never impute

optimizer.name: deterministic limited-memory BFGS with Armijo backtracking
optimizer.non_descent_direction: clear history once and use negative gradient; a second occurrence fails

determinism.parallel_reduction: disabled; sorted folds, sessions, decisions, and lexical actions with sequential float64 batch reduction
determinism.fit_repetition_requirement: two fits on the deterministic fixture and one repeated real-data fold must agree within 1e-10 in coefficients and 1e-12 in objective

finite_and_separation_checks.trigger_action: fail closed; do not change lambda or standardization

cross_fit_contract.population: selected v2 research-exploration arm within official B2 train
cross_fit_contract.assignment: sort assigned exploration players by descending structural decision count then seeded hash; greedily place into a non-full fold maximizing already assigned incident game weight, then minimizing fold player count, fold decision mass, seeded player-fold hash, and fold index
cross_fit_contract.cross_fold_game_policy: discard the entire game from fitting, scoring, variance estimation, and D-to-L estimation
cross_fit_contract.held_out_fold: score only games whose two players are in that fold
cross_fit_contract.training_for_fold: use only same-fold sampled games belonging to the other four folds

exploration_expansion.selection: within each fold greedily select internal games maximizing uncovered participating endpoints with seeded session-hash tie-breaks, then fill by that hash rank

deviation_stop.action: stop and diagnose; do not silently reduce the frozen sample

uncertainty_contract.interval: percentile 2.5 and 97.5 percent from deterministic player-cluster resamples
uncertainty_contract.paired_log_loss_sd: sample standard deviation across evaluable players of geometry-minus-full player mean log loss
uncertainty_contract.sd_uncertainty: bootstrap the player sample standard deviation; readiness uses its 97.5 percentile upper bound
uncertainty_contract.zero_event_policy: observed zero remains zero; no pseudo-count or prior creates an event or effect

power_contract.binding_readiness_basis: N=487 because the frozen primary estimand gives each participating player equal weight; Kish is a required traffic-concentration sensitivity and any conclusion flip is reported
power_contract.pass_rule: the 97.5 percentile SD upper bound must be no greater than 0.01 divided by ((z_0_975 plus z_0_80) divided by sqrt(487))

d_to_l_contract.frozen_source_text: minimum top-versus-bottom risk-quintile D-to-L difference 0.02 and difference lower 95 must meet minimum
d_to_l_contract.evaluation_population: out-of-fold evaluable decisions whose parent positional tier is D
d_to_l_contract.risk: sum of full-model conditional choice probabilities on alternatives whose positional transition is D-to-L
d_to_l_contract.quintile_boundaries: for each held-out fold, weighted 20th and 80th percentiles of full-model risk on that fold's training players only; every training player has equal total weight across parent-D decisions
d_to_l_contract.boundary_quantile: left-continuous weighted empirical quantile in ascending risk then session, ply, and move-key order
d_to_l_contract.held_out_groups: bottom risk is less than or equal to the fold training 20th percentile; top risk is greater than or equal to the fold training 80th percentile
d_to_l_contract.player_weighting: each player has equal total weight across all of that player's held-out parent-D decisions; group rates are ratio estimates from those weights
d_to_l_contract.event: chosen action has positional transition D-to-L
d_to_l_contract.zero_event_players: included with observed event count zero when they have parent-D exposure; no smoothing
d_to_l_contract.players_without_parent_D_exposure: excluded from D-to-L endpoints and counted
d_to_l_contract.degenerate_group_rule: fail if either risk group contains fewer than 10 percent of evaluable parent-D decisions or fewer than 50 players
d_to_l_contract.interval: the same 2000-replicate player-cluster percentile bootstrap with frozen predictions and fold-specific boundaries
d_to_l_contract.precision_projection: scale the exploration player-cluster standard error by the square root of exploration evaluable players divided by the planning N; use the bootstrap 97.5 percentile half-width upper bound
d_to_l_contract.optimistic_pass: projected point difference minus conservative projected half-width at N=487 must be at least 0.02
d_to_l_contract.kish_sensitivity: repeat projection at N=58.91083564214028 and report whether the decision flips
d_to_l_contract.brier_endpoint: geometry Brier minus full Brier for D-to-L risk, averaged equally over players; report player bootstrap interval and projected lower bound

A_requires: all identity and access preflight checks pass
all folds converge for both specifications and pass finite and separation diagnostics
at least 800 exploration players have out-of-fold evaluable decisions
oracle coverage is at least 0.99 and total abstention is at most 0.01
the conservative paired-log-loss SD upper bound passes the N=487 power rule
D-to-L event and event-player support pass
the conservative N=487 D-to-L top-bottom projected lower bound is at least 0.02
the full-model D-to-L Brier projected lower bound exceeds zero

protected_access.allowed_raw_content: only session IDs in the subsequently frozen estimator exploration sample, all of which must belong to selected research-exploration and official B2 train

known_biases.history_recovery_nonrandom: 1751 excluded games contain 35 draws while 92789 retained games contain 26157 draws
